pills: Experience at a Major Cosmetics Company
paragraphs: My name is Karina, and I am a graphic designer.

I studied at a Moscow university from 2017 to 2025 and graduated with an honors degree. Throughout this time, I worked at a major cosmetics company: not just laying out banners, but tackling real-world branding, packaging, and visual communication challenges every single day.

I teach because I know what it feels like to learn design from ground zero. I once wished someone would break everything down clearly without drowning me in jargon. This course is built exactly that way: fluff-free, practical, and focused on why every detail matters.
This course is ideal for anyone who wants to break into graphic design without chaos or unnecessary theory: featuring a crystal-clear structure and assignments closely modeled on real-world projects.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before starting your journey

items.q: How long does the training last?
items.a: The course lasts 1.5 months (6 weeks). Over this period, you will complete 6 weeks of structured practice: 5 mini-projects and 1 final capstone portfolio project. Full access to course materials is maintained for 5 months upon payment verification.

items.q: Can I enroll if I have zero prior drawing or design experience?
items.a: Absolutely. The course starts from absolute ground zero. Freehand drawing skills are not required; we focus on digital tools, typography, and visual rules.

items.q: What software will we be using?
items.a: We use Figma (free, browser-based or desktop app) and Adobe Illustrator. Detailed installation instructions are provided in Week 1.

items.q: How long will I retain access to the materials?
items.a: You will have continuous access to all curriculum materials and PDFs for 5 months from the date of payment confirmation.

items.q: How does payment and enrollment verification work?
items.a: After selecting your tier, transfer details are displayed. Complete the bank/card transfer and send the receipt to the instructor via Telegram (+992 116 41 61 52). Access is activated manually in the admin desk.

items.q: How do Zoom calls take place?
items.a: For Standard and Pro tiers, we arrange convenient meeting times via Telegram. During 45–60 minute sessions, we thoroughly review your assignments and live Figma files.
